rows.text: The government page 'THE LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY', under the heading '1999-2002 Legislative Assembly Membership', lists 'Hon. Veikune (Speaker of the House)' among the Vava'u nobles' representatives, and states that 'The Speaker of the Assembly is being appointed by the King'.

rows.uncertainty: The page is undated; attested_on is the capture date (30 April 2001), when the government site presented him as Speaker, and the page was last modified on 19 February 2001. The roster could lag: the same page, captured again in August 2002 after his successor's appointment had been reported, still marked him Speaker (a lead, listed in the report). No appointment or start date.
